About this digest
  • Next update: Tue Nov 24 (every 5 days, delivered as soon as compiled that morning).

  • Verification: V = confirmed live this run (feed or browser pass) — library totals: 1004 V, 0 U. Beyond: 389 listings (305 V, 84 U). Feed systems reconciled per day (feed total − excluded = kept) for every feed system; the live-browser pass pinned 159 library events across 10 sources (Berkeley 28, Santa Cruz 35, South San Francisco 10, San Leandro 8, Daly City 13, San Bruno 6, Santa Clara City 13, Livermore 13, Menlo Park 11, Redwood City 22). San Bruno's feed fetch failed this run (http=None), so the browser list is the ONLY San Bruno source. Tap the V or U to open the event's page.
  • Flags: "free ticket" = pick up at the Children's desk before the program (Hayward rule — see Closures: free ticket 30 min before, every adult AND child, no advance reservations). "borderline" = skews school-age but includes an under-7 age group. "time not shown on listing" = the source page showed no reliable start time (never invented). All-day events are in Activities with "all day" wording so the renderer buckets them separately. Afternoon school-age/teen events carry an amber Afterschool badge.
  • All library events are free unless noted. Non-library sources (bookstores, parks, museums, zoos, nature, art studios, Eventbrite, parent calendars) are mostly PAID — costs shown distinctly (PAID/FREE) in Beyond.
  • Layout: each day is split into Storytimes vs Activities (nearest-first within each). A Nearest | Earliest | Latest toggle re-sorts every list; all-day events go in the All-day bucket. The For you tab picks by age and city; the Digest tab has the full day lists plus an age bar (All / Baby / Toddler / Preschool / Ages 7+ / Free) and one shared search bar.
  • Heads-ups: Thanksgiving Eve Wed 11/25 — early closures: Berkeley all locations 6:00 PM; Redwood City all libraries 5:00 PM; Livermore Civic Center 6:00 PM; SMCL, Palo Alto, CCCL and Sunnyvale close 5–6 PM (feed notices).
